troubleshooting: If the evidence JSON already exists, rerun formal record with --force only after backing up or confirming replacement.
Normal closeout must not use --force; keep the original evidence ref before confirming any replacement.
Service precheck expects /healthz HTTP 200 with status=ok and the Wave3 route to return 401/AUTH-001 without Authorization; service-url must not point to local/prod/production/mock/fake/stub/example.
Use scan input values containing scan-key, keyevent, intent, or datawedge; do not write camera/phone/browser.
Match stack candidate to Spike refs: react-native uses spike-005, webview-capacitor uses spike-005b.
Every evidence ref must include the current environment token: dev or staging.
Set WAVE_3_PDA_* boolean variables to true only after the matching evidence is present.
